title: Cream & Cognac Days
description: Two distinct outfit directions — a cottagecore-adjacent white ruffle mini with western fringe bag and cognac boots, and a luxe cream lounge set under a shaggy faux fur coat with a chocolate leather tote — unified by a warm ivory-to-brown palette that reads effortlessly chic for weekend errands, brunch, or a city afternoon in cold weather.
occasion: weekend brunch, city errands, casual daytime, cold-weather outings
